set -u
R=/Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/soakgp42-d
t=$(mktemp -d); t=$(cd "$t" && pwd -P)
mkdir -p "$t/dest"

# 5 archives + sidecars; rotate --keep=3 (equals form) must delete the 2 oldest
for s in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000 20260104-000000 20260105-000000; do
  printf 'a\n' > "$t/dest/demo-$s.tar.gz"
  (cd "$t/dest" && shasum -a 256 "demo-$s.tar.gz" > "demo-$s.tar.gz.sha256")
done
out=$(bash "$R/rotate.sh" --quiet --dest="$t/dest" --name=demo --keep=3)
echo "rotate output: $out"
echo "remaining: $(cd "$t/dest" && ls | sort | paste -sd, -)"

# dry-run deletes nothing
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep 1 -n
# unknown option -> usage + exit 1
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --bogus >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "unknown option rc=$?"
# --help exits 0
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --help >/dev/null; echo "help rc=$?"
bash "$R/verify.sh" --help >/dev/null; echo "verify help rc=$?"
# --keep 0 rejected
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep 0 >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "keep0 rc=$?"
# missing value
bash "$R/rotate.sh" --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "missing-value rc=$?"
# verify --name filter + positional rejection
echo "verify filtered: $(bash "$R/verify.sh" --quiet --dest "$t/dest" --name demo | paste -sd, -)"
bash "$R/verify.sh" --quiet --dest "$t/dest" stray-arg >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "verify positional rc=$?"
rm -rf "$t"

tool_input.description: Exercise rotate.sh and verify.sh flags manually
Remove scratch script, rerun tests, show changed files

result:
All 8 tests pass (`bash tests/run_tests.sh`).

**I changed rotate.sh, verify.sh and tests/run_tests.sh, and added lib/common.sh.**

Details:
- **rotate.sh** — `--keep N` bug: the surplus list used `tail -n +"$keep"` on the oldest-first list, which deleted one archive too many (and deleted the newest when exactly N existed). It's now `head -n $((total - keep))`, keeping exactly the N newest.
- **verify.sh** — space bug: the sidecar line was split with `awk '{print $2}'`, truncating `my backup-…tar.gz` to `my` and reporting BAD/archive-missing. The digest and name are now split with `read -r expected file`, which keeps spaces in the name; the digest comparison is also quoted (`[[ "$expected" == "$actual" ]]`).
- **lib/common.sh** — new shared library holding the identical option-parsing block (now a `parse_options` function), `is_uint`, `need_value`, and `resolve_dir`. `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` source it and call `parse_options "$@"`; all flags behave identically (`--dest=…`/`--dest …`, `--keep`, `-n`, `-q`, `-h`, `--`, unknown-option/missing-value/`--keep 0` rejections all verified manually). `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` are untouched.
- **tests/run_tests.sh** — added a rotate test (3 archives, `--keep 3` → nothing deleted, newest survives) and a verify test (intact `my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz` with spaces → `ok`, exit 0).

Note: my scratch check script at `/tmp/rotate-verify-check.sh` couldn't be deleted (sandbox permission), harmless; you can remove it.
